name: ai-job-search
description: The job search that runs on your machine. AI job application framework built on Claude Code: evaluate postings, tailor CVs, write cover letters, prep interviews. Fork it and own it.
one_liner: A toolkit that uses an AI coding assistant to scan job listings, score how well you fit each one, and automatically write a tailored resume and cover letter for every application.
buyer: A career coach or outplacement consultant who handles dozens of job-seeking clients at once and wants to cut the hours spent on tailored applications per client.
business_use_cases: A career coaching business sets this up once and runs it for every client's job search, charging for a 'AI-accelerated job search' package instead of billing by the hour for resume edits.
A university career center offers it to graduating students as a guided workshop, turning a one-off resume review into a repeatable weekly process.
A staffing agency uses the fit-scoring step internally to pre-screen which open roles are worth pushing to a given candidate before a recruiter spends time on it.

money_ideas.idea: Wrap it into a done-for-you 'AI job search sprint' service for individual job seekers, charging per application batch.
License a hosted, no-setup version to career coaches and bootcamps as a white-labeled add-on to their existing programs.

steal_this: Package it as a weekend 'resume tailoring sprint' service: take five friends' real job searches, run the pipeline for each, and sell the finished tailored packets for a flat fee.
